Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); out=g[:]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2]
    rem=set(cells); comps=[]
    while rem:
        s=next(iter(rem)); q=[s]; st={s}; rem.discard(s)
        while q:
            r,c=q.pop()
            for dr in(-1,0,1):
                for dc in(-1,0,1):
                    n=(r+dr,c+dc)
                    if n in rem:
                        rem.discard(n); q.append(n); st.add(n)
        comps.append(st)
    cid={p:i for i,st in enumerate(comps) for p in st}
    # ring centers = bbox centroid of each X component (used for alignment checks)
    cen=[]
    for st in comps:
        cr_=int(round(sum(r for r,_ in st)/len(st))); cc_=int(round(sum(c for _,c in st)/len(st)))
        cen.append((cr_,cc_))
    armmap={}
    for si,st in enumerate(comps):
        cr_=int(round(sum(r for r,_ in st)/len(st))); cc_=int(round(sum(c for _,c in st)/len(st)))
        for (r,c) in st:
            vr = 'U' if r<cr_ else 'D'
            vc = 'L' if c<cc_ else 'R'
            vp = vr+vc
            armmap[(r,c)]=(si,vp)
    oc=set(cells)
    for i,p in enumerate(cells):
        for j,q in enumerate(cells):
            if i>=j: continue
            if p[0]==q[0]:  # horizontal segment: both arms horizontal (left/right) and centers share the row
                seg=[(p[0],c) for c in range(min(p[1],q[1])+1,max(p[1],q[1]))]
                vp, vq = armmap[p][1], armmap[q][1]
                if not ((vp=='RL' and vq=='LR') or (vp=='LR' and vq=='RL')): continue
                if cen[ii:=cid[p]][0]!=p[0] or cen[cid[q]][0]!=q[0]: continue
            elif p[1]==q[1]:
                seg=[(r_,p[1]) for r_ in range(min(p[0],q[0])+1,max(p[0],q[0]))]
                vp, vq = armmap[p][1], armmap[q][1]
                if not ((vp=='UD' and vq=='DU') or (vp=='DU' and vq=='UD')): continue
                if cen[cid[p]][1]!=p[1] or cen[cid[q]][1]!=q[1]: continue
            else: continue
            if not all(m not in oc for m in seg): continue
            for pt in seg: out[pt[0]][pt[1]]=1
    return out

    print(k,'match' if not bad else (bad[:8],'n=',len(bad)))

def analyze(k):
    t=G[k+' input']; o=G[k+' output']
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(len(t)) for c in range(len(t[0])) if t[r][c]==2]
    rem=set(cells); comps=[]
    while rem:
        s=next(iter(rem)); q=[s]; st={s}; rem.discard(s)
        while q:
            r,c=q.pop()
            for dr in(-1,0,1):
                for dc in(-1,0,1):
                    n=(r+dr,c+dc)
                    if n in rem:
                        rem.discard(n); q.append(n); st.add(n)
        comps.append(st)
    fills=[(r,c) for r in range(len(o)) for c in range(len(o[0])) if t[r][c]!=o[r][c]]
    print(k,'comps',len(comps),'fills',len(fills))

    import collections

        pat[(left,right,up,dn)]+=1
    print(dict(pat))

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2]
    rem=set(cells); comps=[]
    while rem:
        s=next(iter(rem)); q=[s]; st={s}; rem.discard(s)
        while q:
            r,c=q.pop()
            for dr in(-1,0,1):
                for dc in(-1,0,1):
                    n=(r+dr,c+dc)
                    if n in rem:
                        rem.discard(n); q.append(n); st.add(n)
        comps.append(st)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    centers=[]
    for st in comps:
        cr=med([r for r,_ in st]); cc=med([c for _,c in st])
        # center must be missing 2 in input
        if (cr,cc) not in set(cells) and all(abs(r-cr)+abs(c-cc)==1 for r,c in st):

    for (a,b) in itertools.combinations(centers,2):
        if abs(a[0]-b[0])+abs(a[1]-b[1])==max(abs(a[0]-b[0]),abs(a[1]-b[1])):  # collinear
            lo,hi=sorted([(min(a[0],b[0]),a[1]+(b[1]>a[1])),(max(a[0],b[0]),a[1])] )
            # handle both axes
